# Cucina Mia RESTAURANT Dubai Marina

> Cucina Mia is an Italian restaurant at Trident Grand Residence in Dubai Marina, a 45-storey, 220-metre residential tower completed in 2010 with 212 apartments and penthouses. The restaurant sits at the base of the tower, a short walk from Jumeirah Beach Residence and The Walk, and serves pizza and Italian dishes to residents and visitors in the marina district.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Cucina Mia is an Italian restaurant at the Trident Grand Residence in Dubai Marina, a residential tower close to Jumeirah Beach Residence. The restaurant is known for its wood-fired pizza oven and indoor and outdoor dining areas. MENASCO carried out the HVAC works for the restaurant, delivering the air-conditioning and ventilation needed for a busy dining environment.
